title: every release has its page, and the recordings say which errors are expected
summary: Fixes to this page; nothing else in the project changed. Every release now has its own page with a stable link (/whats-new/<version>), and /whats-new lists them all. The recordings of v0.2.0-poc showed red errors that are the point of the demo (a guest refused outside its namespace, a visitor shut out when its lease ends) and looked like failures: each one now has a yellow '# expected' line just before it, added by the build from a versioned table, never by editing the real output, and the captions say what you will see. No new recordings: the ones below are v0.2.0-poc's, rebuilt.

features.name: A page per release
features.what: /whats-new/v0.2.0-poc, /whats-new/v0.2.1-poc...: each release's story, cards and recordings at a link you can share, with older, newer and all releases; /whats-new is the index.
features.why: So a past release keeps its explanation after the next one ships.

features.name: Expected errors, labelled
features.what: showcase.py build reads poc/page/whatsnew/annotations.json: a note before each line a rule matches, and a long run of one kind of line kept short with a count. The real lines stay as they were.
features.why: An error you are meant to see should say so: 403 for a guest is the fence working, a timeout after the lease is the expulsion working.
